# rubrik_azure_rcv_archival_location (List Resource)

The `rubrik_azure_rcv_archival_location` list resource lists RCV Azure archival
locations in RSC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "rubrik_azure_rcv_archival_location" "all" {
  provider = rubrik
}

list "rubrik_azure_rcv_archival_location" "by_name" {
  provider = rubrik

  config {
    name = "eastus2-archive"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter archival locations by name. Matches names starting with the given value.
